title: Flammability Limits at Reduced-g Experiment
description: FLARE connects material flammability limits measured on Earth with behavior in microgravity. The retained NASA sources describe an international research program and early ground test-method work.
objective: Develop a method to estimate microgravity flammability limits from reproducible ground-test data.
approach: Combine ground experiments, parabolic flights and theory, with ISS/Kibo verification described in the historical NASA approach. Compare ignition methods and failure criteria before relating ground screening to low-gravity behavior.
experimentHardware: JAXA Solid Combustion hardware described for ISS/Kibo; ground flammability apparatus
flightProgram: Ground and reduced-gravity research; historical ISS/Kibo verification plan
